snip.t: Malate dehydrogenase, aconitase, citrate synthase and succinate dehydrogenase are shared with the TCA cycle.
Cytosol: NADH + Oxaloacetate + H+ <—> NAD+ + Malate (Malate Dehydrogenase)
Mitochondria: Malate + NAD+ <—> NADH + Oxaloacetate + H+ (Malate Dehydrogenase)
Cytosolic NADH reduces oxaloacetate (OAA) to malate via cytosolic malate dehydrogenase (mDH), producing NAD⁺.
In the matrix, mitochondrial malate dehydrogenase oxidizes malate back to oxaloacetate, generating mitochondrial NADH (which feeds into Complex I of the ETC).
